settings.headline:
Catch the wind,
leave the harbour.
settings.copy: Northwind runs small-crew sailing charters along a coastline that rewards patience — quiet coves, steady trade winds, and a skipper who knows every anchorage by name. You bring the appetite for open water; we bring the boat, the crew, and the tide tables.

Full provisioning and picnic lunches included

stats.label: Guests sailed with us, small crews only
Skippers, each with a decade of local water

settings.title: Pick your
settings.intro: Three ways to get out on the water with Northwind — from a relaxed half-day cruise to a week-long blue-water passage, with a full flotilla in between.

design.title: Half-day harbour sail
design.text: Three unhurried hours out of the marina — past the lighthouse, through the channel, and back with a hot lunch aboard. Perfect for first-timers.

design.title: Full-day island hop
design.text: A full day threading the islands — two anchorages, a swim stop, and a spread lunch on deck while the tide turns.

build.title: Two-day coastal passage
build.text: Sail by day, anchor by night. Your skipper picks sheltered coves, and you wake to coffee on a still harbour.

build.title: Five-day blue-water cruise
build.text: A proper passage — overnight watches, open water, and the deep quiet that only comes a day from shore.

launch.title: Private charter
launch.text: The whole boat for your family, friends, or crew. Your dates, your pace, a dedicated skipper and mate.

launch.title: Wedding & celebration sails
launch.text: A champagne sail for your big day — sunset, string lights, and a crew that handles every detail while you toast.

settings.title: Skippers who
settings.intro: Anybody can rent a boat. Northwind gives you a crew that has spent two decades learning this coast — where the wind fills in, which coves stay calm, and how to make guests feel like they've left land behind.

features.title: Licensed, current skippers
features.text: Every charter is led by a USCG-licensed skipper with a decade or more on this stretch of water. Safety briefings are thorough, but never heavy-handed.

features.title: Small crews, real sailing
features.text: We cap every boat well below capacity and run under sail whenever conditions allow. You feel the boat move; you feel the wind work.

features.title: Local anchorage knowledge
features.text: Our skippers know the quiet coves, the fish markets worth a detour, and the sunset spots tourists never find.

features.title: Safety without the fuss
features.text: All boats current on inspection, life jackets for every guest, and a mate aboard on every departure. Confidence comes standard.

features.title: Everything included
features.text: Provisioning, picnic lunches, fuel, and moorage are all in the fare. You show up with sunscreen and a camera.

features.title: Weather-kept promises
features.text: If the forecast turns against us, we rebook or refund. We'd rather reschedule than send you out into a blow.

settings.title: From booking
settings.intro: Planning a sail should feel as easy as the day itself. Here's the simple path from your first enquiry to casting off.

steps.title: Pick your charter
steps.text: Choose a day sail or a passage, and let us know your dates and party size. We'll match you to the right boat and skipper.

steps.title: We confirm the weather
steps.text: We watch the forecast and confirm your departure a day ahead. If the wind won't cooperate, we offer a rebook or full refund.

steps.title: Meet at the marina
steps.text: Your skipper greets you at the dock, runs a friendly safety briefing, and has coffee on. Fifteen minutes later you're casting off.

steps.title: Sail, swim, and unwind
steps.text: The day is yours — sail, anchor, swim, or just sit on the rail and watch the water. We handle the boat; you handle the views.

settings.note: Every Northwind departure is fully insured, crewed, and all-inclusive — our promise that your time aboard is unhurried, safe, and worth the wait for the right wind.

settings.title: The water,
settings.intro: People tell us the same thing: they came for the sail and left planning the next one. Here's what a few guests had to say.

reviews.quote: We've chartered boats on three oceans and Northwind is the first crew that felt like old friends by the end of day one. Our skipper knew every cove, read the wind perfectly, and made us feel completely safe. The full-day island hop was the best money we've spent in years.
reviews.author: Marta J.

reviews.quote: As someone who gets seasick in a bathtub, I was nervous. The crew had me settled with a calm briefing and the smoothest line down the channel — I didn't even think about it. The picnic at anchor was gorgeous.
reviews.author: Daniel R.

reviews.quote: We booked the private charter for our engagement and it was flawless — sunset, string lights, a bottle of something cold, and a skipper who quietly handled every detail. Ten out of ten.
reviews.author: Sofia & Elena

settings.intro: Questions about a charter, a private booking, or a gift sail for someone special? Send us a note — a real crew member replies within one business day.
